content_html:
watched #JERSEY : REEListic Story dealt with REAListic emotions!!!!

a Must watch if you are a fan of movies with emotional content!!!! a one time watch if you are normal movie lover and a Never watch if you are purely into Entertainment or Mass Movies!!!!

What could have been an award winning ir once in life time performance for many other actors…had been a simple cake-walk performance for Nani!!!

Director had done full justice to the emotional theme of the movie and also the cricketing scenes have been shot really well!!!

Audio is pretty ordinary but the BGM though sublime was pretty good in elevating the emotional mood of the film!!!!

Heroine Shraddha, Satyaraj and the little Kid have done complete justice to their respective roles!!!

special mention of the superb dialogues which sounded pretty real and touching like few below….

Baaga aade vadini Captain cheyaaru……aadu Captain avuthe andhharini baagha adisthadu annukunodine Captain ni chestharu!!!!

aadi vyasu ki artham kakappvachu gaani…naaa manusuku telusu ra mosam chesanu anni!!!

maa naana prayatnisthu chanipoyadu anukunam kadhaaa…..kaadhu chanipothadani telisinaa prayatninchaadu!!!

naaku aapu ichinolantha guda nanu dabbullu epudu thirigi isthavu ra anni epudu adagaaru!!! adhi naa medha prema tho kadhu……nenu thirigi ivalenanna namakam tho!!!
